title: Human Approval Schema
description: Structure for recording human (doctor) approval of AI clinical outputs before they may be released as approved_for_use.

approval_record_structure.approval_action: string — enum: APPROVE / APPROVE_WITH_MODIFICATION / REJECT / ESCALATE
approval_record_structure.modification_note: string or null — if APPROVE_WITH_MODIFICATION: what was changed
approval_record_structure.escalation_target: string or null — if ESCALATE: who/where escalated to
approval_record_structure.gate_checked: string — which gate was satisfied: C5 (Feasibility), C6 (Red Team), C7 (Human Approval)
approval_record_structure.pii_confirmed_absent: boolean — doctor confirms no PII in output before approval

invariants: No clinical output may reach release_state='approved_for_use' without a matching approval record.
approval_action MUST be 'APPROVE' or 'APPROVE_WITH_MODIFICATION' to release.
REJECT or ESCALATE actions set release_state to 'doctor_review_required' and block use.
pii_confirmed_absent and disclaimer_confirmed BOTH must be true to release.
Approval records are immutable once created — corrections require a new approval with reference to prior record.
